records.title: Contribution of PMAY-G to Employment Generation in Rural Areas
details:
Question asked by;-
1.Shri Chunnilal Garasiya
2. Shri Mithlesh Kumar
3. Shri Brij Lal
4. Shri Ryaga Krishnaiah
5. Smt. Rekha Sharma
6. Shri Narhari Amin
7. Shri Baburam Nishad
Assurance-Yes. The Ministry of Rural Development is implementing the Pradhan Mantri
Awaas Yojana- Gramin (PMAY-G) w.e.f. 1st April, 2016 to construct 4.95 crore houses by
March 2029 by providing assistance to eligible rural households with basic amenities to attain
the goal of "Housing for All".
